originals.citation: Titov, N., Andrews, G., et al. (2008). Shyness 1: Distance treatment of social phobia over the Internet. Australian & New Zealand Journal of Psychiatry.

quote: In a randomized controlled trial Titov et al. (2008) demonstrated significant benefit from an Internet- and email-based treatment programme for social phobia. The present study (Shyness 2) seeks to replicate that finding
notes: Self-replication. DOI of Shyness 1 not verified.
